Overlap prevention ensures that structures never generate on top of each other.
When enabled, generation is skipped if a new structure would overlap with an existing one.

By default, it applies globally to all structures, but specific namespaces or individual structures can be excluded.

The images below demonstrate how structure overlap prevention works.

## Enabling the overlap prevention
You can enable overlap prevention on the structure settings screen.

<p align="center">
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faboslav/structurify/refs/heads/master/.github/assets/images/wiki/structures/overlap_prevention/overlap_prevention.webp" title="Enabling Overlap Prevention" alt="Enabling Overlap Prevention">
</p>
<br>

## Excluding all namespace structures from overlap prevention
You can exclude all structures within a specific namespace from overlap prevention using the namespace settings.

<p align="center">
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faboslav/structurify/refs/heads/master/.github/assets/images/wiki/structures/overlap_prevention/namespace_overlap_prevention_exclude.webp" title="Exclude namespace from Overlap Prevention" alt="Exclude namespace from Overlap Prevention">
</p>
<br>

## Excluding specific structure from overlap prevention
You can exclude a specific structure from overlap prevention using the structure’s settings.
<p align="center">
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Faboslav/structurify/refs/heads/master/.github/assets/images/wiki/structures/overlap_prevention/structure_overlap_prevention_exclude.webp" title="Exclude structure from Overlap Prevention" alt="Enabling Overlap Prevention">
</p>
